name: Initials XL
description: Initials XL is a very large satin stitch Capital font. It contains the 37 glyphs :ampersand, A-Z and 0-9. In addition the ten glyphs (){}[],;.: are used to store frames. Type any letter followed by any frame (e.g. A( or B; )  to obtain a framed Capital or Number. Warning: for a few large letters you will need to manually enlarge the frame.
